definitions.explanation: Waste material that is thrown away. Includes household waste, litter, and any discarded items.

examples.japanese: ゴミ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}してきます→出す：01087_dasu⟧。
examples.english: I'll go take out the trash.
examples.notes: ゴミを出す = to take out the trash

examples.japanese: ゴミ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{分|わ}けて→分ける：02333_wakeru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.notes: Garbage sorting is important in Japan

examples.japanese: ⟦ここ→ここ：00961_koko⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ゴミ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{捨|す}てないで→捨てる：00892_suteru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。

notes:
ゴミ means trash or garbage. Usually written in katakana.

WRITING FORMS:
- ゴミ: katakana (most common)
- ごみ: hiragana
- {塵|ごみ}: kanji (rare)

JAPANESE TRASH CATEGORIES:
- ⟦{燃|も}えるゴミ→燃えるゴミ：17105_moerugomi⟧: burnable garbage
- ⟦{燃|も}えない→燃える：02312_moeru⟧ゴミ: non-burnable garbage
- ⟦{資源|しげん}ゴミ→資源ゴミ：09537_shigengomi⟧: recyclables
- ⟦{粗大|そだい}→粗大：noentry⟧ゴミ: oversized garbage
- ⟦{生|なま}ゴミ→生ゴミ：08044_namagomi⟧: food waste

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- ゴミ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧: to take out the trash
- ゴミ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{捨|す}てる→捨てる：00892_suteru⟧: to throw away trash
- ゴミ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{分別|ぶんべつ}→分別：07706_bunbetsu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to sort trash
- ゴミ⟦{収集|しゅうしゅう}→収集：11829_shuushuu⟧⟦{日|び}→日：02249_hi⟧: garbage collection day
- ⟦ゴミ{箱|ばこ}→ゴミ箱：06994_gomibako⟧: trash can
- ⟦ゴミ{袋|ぶくろ}→ゴミ袋：22230_gomibukuro⟧: garbage bag

NOTE: Japan has strict garbage sorting rules that vary by municipality.
